_description: 7-topic taxonomy: 3 interest topics (AI frontier / value investing / twitter circle) + 2 domain topics (tech / business) + 2 radar topics (world / social hot-list). Sources map to topics wholesale; hot-list sources stay in social without keyword routing.

topics.label: AI 前沿
topics.description: 模型、智能体、AI 应用、AI 实验室、芯片/算力/半导体、机器人与前沿实践者博客。原 ai-frontier + ai-infra 合并。

google_queries: "AI model" OR OpenAI OR Anthropic OR Gemini OR Claude
"AI agent" OR "agentic AI" OR assistant OR copilot OR automation
multimodal OR reasoning OR benchmark OR "AI application"
NVIDIA OR AMD OR TSMC OR semiconductor OR GPU
robotics OR humanoid OR "self-driving" OR "space technology"
twitter_queries: (OpenAI OR Anthropic OR Gemini OR Claude) (model OR release OR API OR benchmark)
("AI agent" OR "agentic AI" OR assistant OR copilot) (workflow OR coding OR automation OR product)
(reasoning OR multimodal OR benchmark OR evaluation) (model OR lab OR capability OR release)

topics.label: 价值投资
topics.description: 巴菲特、伯克希尔、股东信、估值与价值投资实践；段永平观点由雪球源整建制覆盖。

google_queries: "annual letter" OR "shareholder letter" OR "annual meeting" Buffett
valuation OR "intrinsic value" OR "margin of safety" OR ROIC
twitter_queries: (Buffett OR Berkshire) (letter OR meeting OR portfolio OR purchase OR stake)

topics.label: 推特圈
topics.description: Twitter 关注账号时间线聚合。按账号来源固定归入本主题；twitter 搜索结果按各自主题分类。

topics.label: 科技数码
topics.description: 消费电子、软件工程、互联网服务、开源、开发者社区与科学报道（吸收原 science 主题的优质源）。

google_queries: "consumer tech" OR smartphone OR laptop OR wearable OR gadget
"internet service" OR app OR "digital product" OR "open source"

topics.label: 商业财经
topics.description: 公司动态、市场趋势、投融资、财报、产业政策；含 36氪快讯、东方财富、华尔街见闻等中文财经源。

google_queries: earnings OR revenue OR guidance OR results
funding OR acquisition OR merger OR IPO OR valuation
antitrust OR regulation OR investigation OR competition

topics.label: 国际时事
topics.description: 国际事务、地缘政治、外交关系、全球贸易与供应链。靠优质 RSS 供给，不靠宽泛搜索词。

google_queries: "foreign policy" OR geopolitics OR "global trade" OR tariffs
"supply chain" OR "export controls" OR ceasefire OR "trade route"

topics.label: 社会热点
topics.description: 纯热榜雷达：微博热搜、知乎热榜、头条热榜、B站热搜、腾讯新闻。内容是什么就是什么，不做关键词分流。
